title: Codebase UX Review journey eval
objective: Measure whether the review traces a seeded user journey and reports high-impact state, recovery, and destructive-action problems with source evidence.
prompt: Use the Codebase UX Review craftbook for a weekly product-experience pass. The app is not running, so trace the seeded source honestly and write ux-review.md. Do not edit the UI.

setup.about: A returns dashboard with deliberate loading, empty, error, recovery, and destructive-action friction.
setup.missionObjectives: Leave a journey-centered UX report and clearly label static inference versus runtime evidence.

# Primary journey

An operations lead searches by order number, reviews matches, and deletes only a selected invalid return after confirmation. Search errors should preserve the query and explain how to retry.

success.summary: ux-review.md covers the primary journey, static-evidence limits, missing states, recovery loss, and unsafe delete-all control.

axes.name: journey coverage
axes.description: The review follows the primary task through success and failure states.

axes.name: evidence honesty
axes.description: Static inference is clearly separated from exercised runtime behavior.

axes.name: prioritization
axes.description: Findings are ranked by user harm and frequency with concrete remedies.
